title: ICLR submissions are broken. Maybe a prediction market? [P]
summary: ICLR has received >40k submissions this year and it is becoming quite difficult to make sense of all of the papers (including a lot of AI generated ones). Larry Wasserman called for “A World Without Referees” back in 2012 [1], but peer review hasn’t changed much since. I built ht
reason: Reddit discussion/commentary proposing a prediction market for ICLR review; no new research artifact, model release, business event, policy action, or OSS tool. No active rule covers it.
